Package info.openrocket.core.rocketcomponent

Class AirbrakeSet

java.lang.Object
info.openrocket.core.rocketcomponent.RocketComponent
info.openrocket.core.rocketcomponent.ExternalComponent
info.openrocket.core.rocketcomponent.LeafSet
info.openrocket.core.rocketcomponent.AirbrakeSet
All Implemented Interfaces:
info.openrocket.core.rocketcomponent.BoxBounded, info.openrocket.core.rocketcomponent.position.AxialPositionable, info.openrocket.core.util.ChangeSource, Cloneable, Iterable<info.openrocket.core.rocketcomponent.RocketComponent>
public class AirbrakeSet extends info.openrocket.core.rocketcomponent.LeafSet implements info.openrocket.core.rocketcomponent.position.AxialPositionable, info.openrocket.core.rocketcomponent.BoxBounded
Represents a set of airbrakes attached to a rocket. Airbrakes are used to modify the aerodynamic properties of the rocket by increasing drag, which is useful for controlling descent or adjusting flight performance. This class is a specialized extension of the LeafSet base class. Features: - Provides parameters for the physical dimensions (length, width, thickness) of the airbrakes. - Includes properties such as mass, number of airbrakes, and their center of gravity (CG) offset. - Supports aerodynamics concepts via drag coefficients for perpendicular and parallel orientation. - Exposes methods for calculating physical properties (e.g. fraction of airbrakes exposed). Class behavior: - Implements several abstract methods from LeafSet, though in this implementation these methods primarily return placeholders. - Provides setters for dimension-related attributes with basic validation to ensure physical constraints and meaningful data.
